[SWS_DM_01031] Notification about UDS
DTC
status changes
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04183
⌈
If the AA has registered for a UDS DTC status change notification via the function
ara::diag::DTCInformation::SetDTCStatusChangedNotifier
of the corre-
sponding
ara::diag::DTCInformation
instance, the DM shall call this notifier on
any UDS DTC status change for every single DTC mapped to this fault memory.
⌋
